name: All-Terrain Vehicle
description: Any motor vehicle used for recreational off-road use, which takes in an off-road electric dirt bike as well as a quad.

restrictions.rule: Any motor vehicle used for recreational off-road use, with no limit on wheels, power or speed

Kept off public highways and their rights-of-way, except to cross a two-lane highway at close to a right angle and within two-tenths of a mile, to ride a two-lane highway for farm work, construction, road maintenance or snow removal, or on roads a state, city or county government designates
Ridden on public property only where the agency responsible for it allows, and on private property only with the owner's or tenant's consent
Riders 16 and older must wear an approved helmet on public property
Riders and passengers under 16 must wear an approved helmet, and may ride only under direct parental supervision
Children under 6 may not operate one
A parent may not let a child under 16, or a minor without a permit or license, carry a passenger
Riding on a highway under those exceptions needs a valid operator's license, a headlight and two taillights, and daylight unless clearing snow or doing emergency road maintenance
